milestones.title: Shared tracker
completed: Searched for an existing tracker: /app/roadmap is DB-backed and not readable from the repo, so a JSON tracker was added
docs/prospect-discovery-status.json + docs/prospect-discovery-handoff.md
Read-only /app/project-status page, linked in the sidebar and from Prospect Discovery

milestones.title: Campaign-based discovery
completed: Migration 0007: discovery_campaigns (RLS, org-scoped), campaign_id on lead_import_rows and businesses, same-org trigger, validated status constraints
Discovery form: new or existing campaign, target service, target industry + keyword filter, source, area
Scans and CSV intake attach campaign_id to staged rows; existing OSM/Boston/CSV/dedupe/manual review preserved
Campaign list on Discovery links to the queue filtered by campaign

milestones.title: Deterministic qualification
completed: lib/prospect-qualification.ts: pure deterministic qualifyProspect + staged-row and CRM adapters

Rules: missing website -> find website; missing GBP link -> confirm GBP; social-only = research, not proof; inconclusive audit != problem; geolocation needs real service-area/multi-location evidence (scan area excluded); closed/won/lost/disqualified never priority
Strength and contact readiness derived, not stored; manual overrides for opportunity, confidence and next action
20 tests incl. banned-claim check (no budget/revenue/traffic/rankings)

milestones.title: Usable research queue
completed: Queue rebuilt as compact grouped cards (business | qualification | next action + rationale | actions) with an expandable action panel; no wide table
Each candidate shows campaign, area, industry, website presence, GBP status, opportunity, strength, confidence, contact readiness, next action, research status, duplicate warning, rationale
Filters: campaign, opportunity, strength, confidence, readiness, research status tabs, area, industry, website presence, search; sorted strongest-first
Actions: shortlist, hold, disqualify (evidence reason required), restore, override opportunity/confidence/next action, import to CRM, link duplicate, skip
Falls back to read-only qualification with a banner if migration 0007 is not yet applied

milestones.title: CRM, Opportunity Board and demo handoff
completed: Import carries campaign_id, primary_opportunity, evidence_confidence, next_action and qualification_rationale into businesses; also recorded email/contact/GBP link from CSV evidence; priority_score never set
Disqualified candidates cannot be imported until restored; import falls back to the legacy insert if 0007 is missing
Linking a duplicate only fills an empty campaign_id; never overwrites CRM data

CRM detail: qualification panel (campaign, opportunity, strength, confidence, readiness, next action, rationale), editable with blank = recompute from evidence; links to pitch brief, website demo section and board
Opportunity Board: qualification line per business, campaign and opportunity filters, Pitch brief and Website demo links; same board, same generator (createDemo), no auto-publish

milestones.title: Pitch brief
completed: lib/pitch-brief.ts: pure, tested brief builder (location + verification state, campaign, opportunity, evidence, confidence, unknowns, opening offer, links, audit summary, next action, demo link, claims that must not be made, sources, Markdown)
/app/leads/[id]/pitch: printable (print CSS hides navigation) and copyable (Copy as Markdown + raw Markdown block)
Linked from CRM qualification panel and Opportunity Board
